caption: The drawing depicts a single long brown coat displayed against a plain light beige background. The coat has a double-breasted front with six visible buttons in two parallel rows, and it features wide lapels with buttonholes. The sleeves are full-length and slightly puffed at the shoulders, tapering down to fitted cuffs. The coat flares out below the waist, creating a skirt-like appearance, and the inside lining visible through the front opening appears to be a slightly darker, muted shade. The overall composition centers the coat on the page, without any additional objects or background details.
title: Man's Topcoat
